statements.impact_statement: This exact Wolfi package contains CPython 3.12.14's cookie validation fix. NVD's generic <3.13.13 CPE range misses the 3.12 backport. ci/test_runtime_media.py exercises update, |= and output validation in the built runtime before this VEX is used. Source: https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/2abcf904b8dac8c999d2b3aac76681abb333798a/Lib/http/cookies.py . See docs/ci.md for build provenance.

This exact Wolfi package contains CPython 3.12.14's native content-model recursion guard. NVD's generic <3.13.13 CPE range misses the 3.12 backport. ci/test_runtime_media.py verifies deep DTD parsing raises RecursionError rather than crashing before this VEX is used. Source: https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/2abcf904b8dac8c999d2b3aac76681abb333798a/Modules/pyexpat.c . See docs/ci.md for build provenance.

This exact Wolfi package builds CPython 3.12.14 against system Expat >=2.8.0, including both the 16-byte hash salt patch and the new Expat API. NVD's generic <3.13.14 CPE range misses the 3.12 backport. ci/test_runtime_media.py verifies the installed APK revision, Expat version, shared dependency and XML_SetHashSalt16Bytes binary reference before this VEX is used. Source: https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/2abcf904b8dac8c999d2b3aac76681abb333798a/Modules/pyexpat.c . See docs/ci.md for build provenance.
